outreach.subject: Quick thought on Dental Clinic Near Me in Sta. Ana
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking up dental care options in the Tejeron area and came across your Facebook page. It's great that you're active there, but I noticed something that might be costing you new patients.

Right now, relying solely on a Facebook profile means potential clients without an account get hit with a login wall, and you're missing out on Google search traffic. Plus, the long numerical URL makes it tough to share professionally.

We put together a quick, clean demo of what a dedicated site could look like for your clinic. Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul

---

Dr. Marri and Dr. Ralph are my favorites—they both have such a gentle touch, making braces adjustments and teeth cleaning very comfortable. I also really appreciate how accommodating they are whenever I have important occasions or events coming up. They make an effort to close or minimize the gaps in my teeth whenever possible so I can feel more confident during those special occasions.

Another thing I really value is how transparent they are throughout the entire treatment. They explain what is currently happening with your teeth, what needs to be addressed, and what procedures may be necessary in the future to achieve the best possible results. You’re never left wondering what comes next because they give you a clear idea of the treatment plan and timeline.

They can also provide an estimate of the possible cost of upcoming procedures in advance. This is especially helpful because it gives you enough time to prepare, save, and allocate your budget instead of being surprised by unexpected expenses.

The clinic itself is always very clean and well-maintained. If you happen to arrive early, they even have complimentary biscuits and drinks while you wait.

I honestly wish they would open more branches in the future, especially somewhere closer to Parañaque—and hopefully Dr. Marri could have a schedule there too!
